leadText:
Stefano (Japanese: シゲキ Shigeki) is a character of the day who appeared in Disguise Da Limit. He is a Pokémon Coordinator who entered the Verdanturf Town Pokémon Contest with his in hopes of winning the prestigious Verdanturf Ribbon.

Although his performance in the first round was not shown, it was deemed impressive enough by the panel of judges and put him in the Battle Stage of the Verdanturf Contest together with , Timmy, and Jesslana. There, he and his were matched up against May and her . However, Wartortle ended up being defeated with relative ease. As a result, Stefano was eliminated from the competition.
